note: Status verified live on 2026-09-02. A registry that does not answer on measurement day stays in the table with its reason — it is never silently omitted.

registries.note: Ours. Marked as such in every output: whoever reads this benchmark must know who publishes it without having to look it up.

Added 2026-09-02. Verified live before adding, not assumed from its listing: POST /search returns ARD-shaped results with identifier, score and source, and it serves a genuine canary-clean /.well-known/ard.json. Its crawler indexes us, which is federation working as the spec describes — and is disclosed here because it means the two registries are not independent observers of each other.

registries.excluded: Does not speak ARD: returns 404 to POST /search with the spec's request body and serves its own /v0.1/search instead. Re-verified 2026-08-31. Listed with its reason rather than deleted, so it does not look like we picked convenient rivals.
